summary: Specified that sync-core threads the resolved repo root from assembleStateFromBundles into toPipelineState before derivePRLinks is called.
Clarified that derivePRLinks receives the stage derived by toPipelineState and uses it to gate mergeCommit resolution via a single-ref rev-parse.
Added an explicit derive-pr-links graceful-failure contract for missing branches, empty git log output, and origin lookup failures, with matching acceptance and test expectations.
Updated the RecentActivity integration snippets to pass activityEvents, matching the planned component props.
